keywords: Robbery/aggravated robbery – Firearm allegation – No Government Analyst evidence proving recovered object was a firearm – Identification evidence – No identification parade – Dock identification seven years later – Recent possession of stolen three-wheeler – Presumption from possession – Convictions under robbery provisions set aside – Conviction substituted for dishonestly receiving/retaining stolen property – Three years rigorous imprisonment – Appeal dismissed subject to variation.
